fieldValues.title: A prerequisite is a recorded edge, and ranked work pulls its blockers out of parking
fieldValues.move: When work depends on another issue it records a GitHub blocked-by edge, not only prose; clerk steward flags issues that name a prerequisite in text ("Blocked by:", "once X lands") with no edge. clerk board rollup gives a blocker at least the priority of the ranked work it blocks. A parked blocker of ranked work appears on the owner's desk under Needs you, with the work it holds up, so it is re-grounded to that work's problem.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Dependencies nobody has written down anywhere. Choosing which problem a blocker should answer: that stays a human call on the desk.
fieldValues.falsifier: Ranked work waits a full cycle on a parked issue and the desk never shows it.
fieldValues.return_when: After two cycles of the desk listing blockers, or the next time a parked blocker is found by hand.
